notes.title: Outbreak Log 5
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

After a long hiatus, and spending a lot of time working on the game, we decided to start doing our Monster Outbreak Dev Logs again! Expect monthly logs from now on! Lots has happened since the last log:

[h3]Slime King[/h3]
The Slime King is one of our upcoming bosses. He will keep players on their toes by trapping them in slime prisons, going after structures, and raining slime down from above! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39894864/5f8ee65ebc247cd32be6dab2332bcdfc18ebf062.gif[/img]


[h3]In-Game Shop[/h3]
Another recent addition to the game is Favians shop! Favian will always be around when you need him to sell you new weapons, structures, and player skins with your hard earned gold. So far the shop carries all of the structures added to the game so far as well as the new bronze and steel swords!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39894864/6f264378288272cd6054fb762b8dd904ac618b66.gif[/img]


[h3]Environments[/h3]
We have been hard at work getting together tile maps and environment sprites for all of the levels for the game. The tile maps that we have gotten done this past month are the desert and undead tilemaps, and we are continuing to work on the sprites for each. The desert tile map will be full of sprites like cacti, palm trees, and old ruins! The undead map on the other hand will have barren trees, and cemeteries to match!


[h3]Monsters[/h3]
To match the undead environment, we wanted to have a bunch of skeletons to match. So far we have 4 skeletons that we have added. The bow and mage skeletons will attack from a distance, while the swordsman and spearman will come in close. The spearman has a strong shield as well to defend itself from incoming attacks!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39894864/35414254f3c6cf660c82a93a12a940e93c2d8b6a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Outbreak Log 4
notes.content:
[h2]Monsters[/h2]

[url=https://gamemunchers.com/blog/2021/04/16/outbreak-log-4/][img]https://i0.wp.com/gamemunchers.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Gribocheque.gif?fit=746%2C296&ssl=1[/img][/url]

Hello! This week we have a few monsters to show off! First off as you can see above we have a mushroom monster! Some creatures in Monster Outbreak will be laying traps for the player to walk over, and as you could probably guess, the mushroom here has a poisonous purple spore trap that will cause the player to lose health!

Next on the list here is the Blue Bomber:

[url=https://gamemunchers.com/blog/2021/04/16/outbreak-log-4/][img]https://i1.wp.com/gamemunchers.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Ticker_monster_move.gif?resize=600%2C432&ssl=1[/img][/url]

[url=https://gamemunchers.com/blog/2021/04/16/outbreak-log-4/][img]https://i0.wp.com/gamemunchers.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Ticker_1.gif?resize=750%2C303&ssl=1[/img][/url]

notes.title: Outbreak Log 3
notes.content:
This week, we have a few things to talk about. In the art department as you can see, we have the pixel art for our dimensional orb all done. This orb is what starts it all, and we wanted to open our game with this little guy for the exposition in the beginning of our game. The world map is also coming along nicely, although we don’t want to show that off yet as it is not quite done.


[url=https://gamemunchers.com/blog/2021/04/08/outbreak-log-3/][img]https://i2.wp.com/gamemunchers.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Glowing_orb_2.gif?fit=640%2C360&ssl=1[/img][/url]

[h2]MULTIPLAYER![/h2]

One of the things that we started working on this week was multiplayer!! You can see two characters hanging out here in the lobby below:

[url=https://gamemunchers.com/blog/2021/04/08/outbreak-log-3/][img]https://i1.wp.com/gamemunchers.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Screenshot-264.png?resize=768%2C568&ssl=1[/img][/url]

We wanted a lobby that allowed players the freedom to walk around and do what they need before the game starts, and this is only one of the lobbies that will be available in the full game.

As of right now, we expect that the game will have up to 4 people playing together at one time. We plan on having the basic survival co-op mode, as well as a ‘battle mode’ where you compete who can survive the longest, and a third where you protect a structure / point of interest from monsters.

Right now, we are working on getting the multiplayer running in a playable state, then we will begin creating UI and systems to stitch everything together.

That’s all for this week!

notes.title: Outbreak Log 1
notes.content:
[h2]Demo??[/h2]
One week ago, we said we would be doing a dev log for Monster Outbreak every week. So here we are.

We decided to delay releasing our demo (originally intended for March), to add more things that will be in the full game:

[list]
[*] Showcase the in-game cutscenes with a tutorial sequence.
[*] In-game map to showcase game world and campaign structure.
[/list]

Additionally, we wanted to spend a little more time to polish other aspects of the game:

[list]
[*] Menu’s and UI.
[*] Audio.
[*] In-game sprites and tilesets.
[/list]

[h2]Progress[/h2]
Okay, since last week we have added the dialogue system that the in-game cutscenes will use (with proper support for localization down the road):
[list]
[/list]
[url=https://i2.wp.com/gamemunchers.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/scenesample-1.gif?resize=750%2C514&ssl=1][img]https://i2.wp.com/gamemunchers.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/scenesample-1.gif?resize=750%2C514&ssl=1[/img][/url]

We also started work on the in game map that will be used in-game to travel between levels:
[list]
[/list]
[url=https://i2.wp.com/gamemunchers.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/unknown.png?resize=768%2C559&ssl=1][img]https://i2.wp.com/gamemunchers.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/unknown.png?resize=768%2C559&ssl=1[/img][/url]

[h2]Next Week[/h2]
For the next week, we plan on having the system for in-game cutscenes more fleshed out, and having the in-game map finished up. Keep an eye out here on steam or our [url=https://gamemunchers.com/blog/] blog page [/url] for updates!

Cheers!
